# Figurich (数字狂徒)

> Figurich is an AI-powered personal wellbeing platform. It offers five integrated products designed to help individuals reconnect attention, habits, daily rhythm, output, and support with real life — not more screen time, not more productivity hacks.

## Products

- [Focus & Digital Detox Kit](https://figurich.com/focus-kit/): The lightest entry point. Combines a digital detox playbook, low-noise content subscription, and simple rhythm prompts to calm the input layer first.
- [OpenClaw Health Kit](https://figurich.com/openclaw-health/): The flagship smart-home health layer. Uses home camera, home speaker, skills, and plugins to bring reminders, observation, tracking, and feedback into your real environment.
- [Content Automation Kit](https://figurich.com/content-creation-kit/): Turns topic selection, drafting, polishing, and publishing into a reusable flow instead of relying on occasional bursts.
- [Personal Branding & OPC Kit](https://figurich.com/personal-branding/): Organises your rhythm, perspective, content, and long-term expression into a stable structure with owned channels and connection paths.
- [Companion Group](https://figurich.com/vip-companion/): The highest-touch support layer for people who know the direction but need feedback, Q&A, structure, and steady companionship while executing.

## About

Figurich (数字狂徒) approaches personal wellbeing through five layers — from calming digital noise (Focus Kit) to embedding AI health tracking in your home (OpenClaw), streamlining content output, building a personal brand, and offering ongoing human support. The products are designed to work together progressively but each can be adopted independently.
